<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
family_for_model_type(model_type: str) -> FamilySpec
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.families`](/api/evoxc-hf/families/)

Also available as `evoxc_hf.family_for_model_type`.

Resolve an HF `model_type` string (e.g. `"mistral"`) to its family.
Delegates the mapping to `evoxc_hf.config.FAMILY_BY_MODEL_TYPE` — the
same table `ModelConfig.from_dict` uses — so registry lookups and
config parsing can never disagree.

## Parameters

- `model_type` · `str` — the raw HF `model_type` from `config.json`.

## Returns

- `FamilySpec` — the family implementing that architecture (`"mistral"` → the `llama` family).

## Raises

- `HFUnsupportedError` — `model_type` is not supported; the message lists
  the supported `model_type` values in sorted order.
